entities.summary: English, a notable figure in the history of Barbados, associated with Sugar Revolution and the Slave Society (1640–1700). Preceded by Sugar Revolution and Barbados becomes wealthiest English colony by 1660s. Their legacy influenced Mature Plantation Society — 'Little England'.
